## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Adyen page is a **Web integration chooser** for FPX Online Banking Malaysia. It routes readers to method-specific Drop-in and Components child guides and to the Web Sessions/Advanced main integration guides. It is navigation, not a source for method eligibility, SDK/API versions, issuer setup, redirect outcomes or completed payments. [[adyen]] [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **UI routes:** The Drop-in child is presented as an all-in-one Web UI; the Components child is described with `MolPayEBankingMY`. Those descriptions point to child guides, rather than specifying import, configuration or request fields here. (raw lines 19–27)
- **Main integration:** The page instructs the reader to create the main integration before adding FPX and links Web Drop-in and Web Components routes for both Sessions and Advanced flows. (raw lines 29–36)

## Detail locators

- Web purpose and method-specific child routes: raw lines 15–27.
- Main-integration prerequisite and four Web flow/UI routes: raw lines 29–36.
